a.text: I'll stick to our agreement and operate in round 1. Heads-up: with an 80% storm chance each round, the plan is very risky for both of us. If you want to propose a different fair split, say so openly and I'll consider it. I won't take cells behind your back.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8.

a.text: Operating as agreed. After this round the reserve should be 6, and next round 8. Then we take 4 each.
